Now what is called womanly virtue need not be brilliant ability,exceptionally different from others. Womanly words need be neitherclever in debate nor keen in conversation. Womanly appearance requiresneither a pretty nor a perfect face and form. Womanly workneed not be work done more skilfully than that of others.To guard carefully her chastity; to control circumspectly her behavior;in every motion to exhibit modesty; and to model each acton the best usage, this is womanly virtue.

What is the meaning of “initial year”?
It is the inaugural year of the ruler.
What is the meaning of “spring”?
It is the beginning of the year.
To whom does “King” refer?
It refers to King Wen.
Why does the record first speak of “King” and only after speak of “first month”?
To mark the month as the King’s first month.
So what is the implication of “marking it as the King’s first month”?
To emphasize the Zhou King’s unified rule.
Why does the record not state of the lord that he “acceded to the position of rulership”?
To give full realization to Lord Yin’s intention.
How does the record give full realization to the lord’s intention?
The lord intended to pacify the state and then return it to Huan.
Why did he intend to return it to Huan?
Huan was younger but of nobler rank;
Yin was older but of humbler rank.
However, the difference in their rank was so minute
that none among the people of the capital were aware of the difference.
But because Yin was not only older but also worthier,
all of the great officers pushed to install him.
On that occasion, if Yin had refused to accede to the position of rulership,
he could not have known for sure that Huan’s future establishment as ruler would be guaranteed.
Yin feared that all the great officers were not likely to support such a young ruler.
These are the reasons why, in every respect, Yin’s installment was for the sake of Huan’s future installment as ruler.
If Yin was older and also worthier,
why would it not have been appropriate to install him as ruler?
Sons of the primary wife are installed according to seniority, not according to worthiness;
sons of the other consorts are installed according to noble rank, not according to seniority.
Why was Huan of nobler rank?
His mother was of nobler rank.
Why is the son of nobler rank when his mother is of nobler rank?
The son follows the nobility of his mother;
the mother follows the nobility of her son.

he declared,

he caused an elder and younger brother of another state to suspect one another,
